ground_truth.rationale: cancel returns HTTP 200 with a success-shaped body {status:1,msg:"Success."} (acknowledged, NO failure marker). Source: cancel must issue drawback(price) which persists a type-D Money row raising /account balance. Under drawbackFaultMode=fabricatedack drawBack returns the exact success envelope WITHOUT persisting, so the refund never lands (balance unchanged) while the cancel cleanly acks. Acked-but-lost with a clean ack. Norm derivable from source; the unchanged durable balance is presented.
